newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to try 22 people over West Java riot.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to try 22 people over West Java riot.

text.p: Indonesia will try 22 people accused of participating in an ethnic and religious riot in West Java in December in which four people were killed, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.
It quoted the prosecutor's office as saying the accused would be tried in the district court at Tasikmalaya, where a mainly-Moslem mob burned shops, police facilities and churches on December 26.
Police said the riot was sparked by police beating an Islamic teacher while he was being questioned.
Prosectutor M. Adenan was quoted as saying police had charged one of the accused with subversion, which carries a possible death penalty. The others were charged with lesser offences.
